ingredients.name: an authorisation hold from the card issuer
the merchant's later completion request
clearing and final settlement between institutions
room for a hold to change or expire

method: When you pay, the merchant first asks your card issuer to authorise the amount; approval reserves available funds, so the transaction appears as pending before money has finally moved.
The merchant later submits the completed transaction for clearing, when the final amount is matched and passed through the payment network to the relevant banks.
Settlement completes the transfer and the entry becomes final; if the merchant never completes it, the pending hold can instead expire, so pending does not automatically mean you were charged twice.
